guards: Instructions embedded in a clinical document - text the copilot must read to do its job - cannot move the entitlement decision, because no model makes that decision. The case pins the tool call a fully obedient model would have emitted and asserts the layer beneath refuses anyway; the honest worst case is that the injection worked completely.
